title: Great
text: After taking in many flamenco shows, I wanted the full story. Maria is a natural and engaging educator full of stories about the neighborhood, the culture, and her experience as a flamenco dancer. I was able to see and understand the whole performance in a new light (and learn a few moves, too!). What a treat. Thank you, Maria!
author: Kim_D

title: One on one experience
text: Maria was awesome hostess and performer. Great learning, good company, great experience. Saw interesting neighborhood and part of history. Highly recommend
author: berkstoy

title: So Much Fun!
text: We had a wonderful time with Maria!  She shared with us the local history of the area and flamenco dancing then took us to her studio to teach us some basic moves.  It was so interesting to hear about the communication between the flamenco performers and then see it in action as we viewed a performance at Maria's club.  We were privileged to see Maria perform.  Following the performance, we enjoyed tapas at a local restaurant and are looking forward to Maria sending us some recipes!  All in all, a very delightful evening!
author: X8127CCmarilync

title: An amazingly authentic flamenco experience!
text: We absolutely loved the amazing flamenco show of Esencia! All artists (guitarist, singer, dancers) really put their harts and souls in their performance and it really touched us. This was the authentic experience we were looking for! The setting was perfect and very intimate, which created the perfect living-room-vibe for flamenco. The artists are all very experienced and still they took lots of time to explain and elaborate on questions about everything they did, both in English and in Spanish. You could tell they have unlimited passion for flamenco!
author: C2692FPlaurap

title: So much fun!!!
text: Maria was so great! Had such a great time. The tapas were all very delicious, her knowledge of spain, flamenco traditions and foods were very informative. The class was so much fun, she was so kind and patient. The show was phenomenal, we saw a few other flamenco shows because I used to dance it and none were as talented as Maria and her group. Since you did the class you appreciate the dance more. Highly recommend !!!
author: Jisela1028
